headline: Pakistan U-19 beat India by three wickets in the ACC Men's Under-19 Asia Cup in Muscat on Sunday, with Hamza Zahoor scoring an unbeaten 100 off 108 balls, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Muscat mein U-19 Asia Cup match 3 wickets se jeeta

caption:
Pakistan U-19 ne India ko 3 wickets se hara diya! 🏏
Dawn ke mutabiq Sunday ko Muscat ke Al Amerat Cricket Ground mein ACC Men's Under-19 Asia Cup ke Group A match mein Pakistan ne 209 runs ka hadaf 48.1 overs mein 211-7 bana kar poora kiya. Hamza Zahoor ne 108 balls par nabad 100 runs banaye, jabke Pakistan ek waqt 61-5 par tha. Pakistan 4 points ke saath Group A mein top par hai.
Hamza Zahoor ki is inning ko aap kitne number denge? Comment mein batayein 👇
